content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Indianapolis

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience to qualify for the PMP® exam. Review PMI's documented requirements—education level, years of experience, and contact hours—to ensure you meet the credential's standards before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. Attend all scheduled sessions from your Indianapolis location, interact with active certified practitioners, and cover the full PMBOK® Guide framework required to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay the PMI exam fee and allow time for application review before scheduling your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and review sessions to build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE test center and demonstrate mastery of project-management knowledge and competencies.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, commit to earning professional development units (PDUs) throughout a standard three-year renewal cycle. Stay current with continuing education, audit requirements, and recertification deadlines set by PMI to keep your credential active.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
